title: Nine Pounds and Forty Years
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：bank　|　正文 330 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bank 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 my grandmother opened ① a bank account with nine pounds and never used it, and she said the opening was the whole of the achievement. The ② bank, meaning the building and not the money, was on the corner for forty years and was pulled down in March; a bank, she said, is the only place that pays you for leaving things alone.

Every ③ bank in that town closed at three, and the ④ bank on the hill, meaning the one with the stone steps and not either of those, was the only one that ever lent anybody anything. A bank, my mother said, is nine parts caution and one part a person willing to sign; my grandmother said the caution is the part they advertise.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bank was the whole of the river, meaning the side and not the building. The ⑥ bank, meaning the earth at the edge and not any of that, is the only part of a river that belongs to somebody; a bank, he said, is either where you keep money or the only word that means both an edge and an institution. She said the edge came first.

By 1975 the ⑦ bank had become a machine in a wall, and the machine had become an argument about whether anybody was still there. The ⑧ bank of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in April, was nine pounds and forty years of caution; a bank, she said, is either the building on the corner or the reason you learned to write your name. She said the name was the part that counted.

The ⑨ bank I remember is the stone steps, which were swept every morning by a man who never went inside. A ⑩ bank, my father said in 1978, is the only institution that improves by being avoided; every bank, she said, is an edge that has agreed to look like a building. He said the edge is still there.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 银行（指那座楼，与钱相对）
C. 固定搭配：open a bank account 开一个银行账户
D. n. 银行（指镇上每一家）
E. n. 银行（指山上那一家）
G. n. 河岸（抽象：边缘那块地）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bank account with nine pounds
The bank, meaning the building and not the money
bank was the whole of the river
The bank, meaning the earth at the edge
the bank had become a machine in a wall
The bank of the whole thing
A bank, my father said in 1978

answers.why: open a bank account 意为“开一个银行账户”，1949 年祖母用九镑开了一个银行账户，却从没用过。
bank 意为“银行”，指那座楼而不是钱，它在街角立了四十年，三月被拆掉。
bank 指镇上每一家银行，那个镇上每一家都三点关门。
bank 指山上那一家银行（有石头台阶的那一家），是唯一肯借钱给人的。
bank 意为“河岸”，父亲说 bank 就是整条河，指的是河的那一侧而不是那座楼。
bank 为抽象用法，指边缘那块地，是一条河上唯一归属于某个人的部分。
bank 意为“银行”，到 1975 年这个 bank 成了墙上的一台机器。
bank 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，祖母四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九镑和四十年的谨慎。
bank 意为“银行（那座楼）”，我记得的是那些石头台阶，每天早晨由一个从没进去过的人打扫。
bank 为抽象总称，父亲说银行是唯一会因为没人上门而变得更好的机构。
